met_analysis:
The Low-Pressure Area over northeast Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood with associated cyclonic circulation extending upto 4.5 km above mean sea level persisted over the same region at 1430 Hrs IST of today, the 28th August 2026. It is very likely to become less marked during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Amritsar, Dehradun, Kheri, centre of Low Pressure Area over northeast Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood, Madhupur, Bankura and thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Bay of Bengal & adjoining West Bengal-Bangladesh coasts extending upto 7.6 km above mean sea level titling southwestwards with height persists. Under its influence, a low pressure area is likely to form over northwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining West Bengal-north Odisha coasts around 29th August, 2026.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Haryana & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 75°E to the north of Lat. 29°N persists.
